glosses: istniejący, występujący w zbyt małej ilości, by zaspokoić zapotrzebowanie

examples.text: Being a professional poet is a nice job, albeit unprofitable.

The undermediators are not required, have nothing properly to do, no peculiar duty to perform; but are an unprofitable or inutile set of beings sitting down and looking at each other through want of other occupation.

Soon after breakfast Miss Matilda, having galloped and blundered through a few unprofitable lessons, and vengeably thumped the piano for an hour, in a terrible humour with both me and it, because her mama would not give her a holiday, […]
In some places, however, quartz reefs, payably auriferous while in Silurian rock, have been followed down to subjacent granite, and have there been found to thin out and become unprofitable […]

glosses: A person or thing that fails to make a profit.

examples.text: The briefing to the Board set out four areas where changes were proposed in the amount attributable to InterCity. Transferring loss-making services to Provincial and taking over Gatwick Express and London-Norwich gave a benefit of £14m.

glosses: Qui se solde par un déficit comptable : non rentable.

examples.text: Le ministre a présenté un budget déficitaire.
L’érosion du marché a rendu l’entreprise déficitaire.

glosses: Qui est insuffisant ; qui se solde par un manque, une pénurie.

examples.text: Récolte déficitaire, qui est inférieure en rendement aux besoins de la consommation.
Certaines personnes ont une attention déficitaire : il ne peuvent se concentrer.
„Besonders dringlich war es, die aufgeblähten defizitären Staatsbetriebe zu privatisieren.“
